title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 on Ubuntu and AlmaLinux, an unauthenticated…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 on Ubuntu and AlmaLinux contain a session management vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker who obtains a valid Splunk Web session cookie before the user logs out can continue to use that cookie after logout to access the user's data and perform actions. This occurs because the logout process does not invalidate the session token. The vulnerability requires the attacker to acquire the session cookie prior to logout.
